create or alter procedure graph.PopulatePathsForAssetType @assetTypeID int, @assetID bigint = null as begin set nocount on;
if @assetTypeID is null begin RAISERROR ('Required parameter @assetTypeID not supplied or is NULL.', 10, 1); end
declare @sql nvarchar(max) = '', @columnSql nvarchar(max) = '', @segmentSql nvarchar(max) = '', @fromSql nvarchar(max) = '', @whereSql nvarchar(max) = '', @matchSql nvarchar(max) = 'a1';
declare @a table(RowID int identity, AssetTypeID int); declare @f table(RowID int, AssetTypeID int, FieldTypeID int, KeyOrder int);
with c as ( select T.ID as AssetTypeID, I.SubjectID as ParentID, T.Object, T.ObjectID, 1 as [Level] from AssetType T left join IntersectType I on I.Object = T.Object and I.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and I.PredicateID in (select ID from [Predicate] where Type = 3) where T.ID = @assetTypeID union all select T.ID as AssetTypeID, I.SubjectID as ParentID, T.Object, T.ObjectID, C.Level + 1 as Level from AssetType T inner join c on T.Object = c.Object and T.ObjectID = c.ParentID outer apply ( select SubjectID from IntersectType where Object = T.Object and ObjectID = T.ObjectID and PredicateID in (select ID from [Predicate] where Type = 3) ) I ) insert into @a select AssetTypeID from c order by Level desc
insert into @f select A.RowID, A.AssetTypeID, F.ID, F.ColumnOrder from @a A inner join FieldType F on F.AssetTypeID = A.AssetTypeID and F.IsPartOfKey = 1 order by A.RowID, F.ColumnOrder, F.Name
select @columnSql = string_agg('''[''+' + 'f'+cast(RowID as nvarchar)+'k'+cast(KeyOrder as nvarchar)+'.[FormattedValue]' + '+'']''', '+''.''+') from @f
declare @current int = 1, @max int, @atID int, @sCurrent nvarchar(30) = '' select @max = max(RowID) from @a while @current <= @max begin set @sCurrent = cast(@current as nvarchar(30)) select @atID = AssetTypeID from @a where RowID = @current set @fromSql = @fromSql + iif(@current > 1, ', ', '') + 'graph.AssetNode a'+@sCurrent set @fromSql = @fromSql + iif(@current > 1, ', graph.AssetEdge e'+ @sCurrent, '')
select @fromSql = @fromSql + ', ' + string_agg('FieldDetail f'+@sCurrent+'k'+cast(KeyOrder as nvarchar), ', ') from @f where RowID = @current select @whereSql = @whereSql + string_agg(' and a'+@sCurrent+'.ID = f'+@sCurrent+'k'+cast(KeyOrder as nvarchar)+'.AssetID and f'+@sCurrent+'k'+cast(KeyOrder as nvarchar)+'.FieldTypeID = '+cast(FieldTypeID as nvarchar), ' ') from @f where RowID = @current
select @segmentSql = @segmentSql + iif (@segmentSql<>'', '+', '') + string_agg('''<segment level="' + @sCurrent+'" assetTypeId="'+cast(@atID as nvarchar)+'" assetId="''+cast(a'+@sCurrent+'.ID as nvarchar)+''">''+' + 'f'+@sCurrent+'k'+cast(KeyOrder as nvarchar)+'.FormattedValue' + '+''</segment>''', '+') from @f where RowID = @current
set @matchSql = @matchSql + iif(@current > 1, '-(e'+ @sCurrent + ')->a'+ @sCurrent, '') --a1 -(e1)->a2 -(e2)->a3
if @current = @max begin set @whereSql = ' a'+ @sCurrent + '.AssetTypeID = ' + cast(@atID as nvarchar) + iif(@assetID is not null, ' and a'+ @sCurrent + '.ID = ' + cast(@assetID as nvarchar), '') + @whereSql select @segmentSql = '''<path>''+' + @segmentSql + '+''</path>'' as Segments' end
set @columnSql = iif(@current = @max, 'a'+ @sCurrent + '.ID as AssetID, ', '') + @columnSql + iif(@current = @max, ' as [Path]', '')
set @current = @current+1 end
set @columnSql = @columnSql + ', ' + @segmentSql
if @matchSql <> 'a1' begin set @matchSql = 'match(' + @matchSql+ ')' set @whereSql = ' and ' + @whereSql end else begin set @matchSql = '' end
set @sql = 'update T set T.[Path] = S.[Path], T.[Segments] = S.[Segments] from graph.AssetNode T inner join (select ' + @columnSql + ' from ' + @fromSql + ' where ' + @matchSql + @whereSql + ') S on S.AssetID = T.ID' execute sp_executesql @sql end
